integrity: Finite classification uses exact integer/rational arithmetic and a proved finite-window criterion; no independent mathematical audit or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for permutation memory lengths from two through the period plus one, periods two through five, the stated initial data, and eventual scalar period collapse. title: First nonrotational scalar collapse in permutation-memory Fibonacci recurrences
